Click Gallery under its list of links.
Check that the curated examples page opens without signing in.
Check the example cards and directory content are set by the product team, not by users, and compare with Expected.
S107.04.where: Open the sitemap page (apps/web route /sitemap-page) > Gallery. Public routes /gallery and /plugins also exist.

S107.11.needs: a Free account and a public shared conversation link
S107.11.note: The copy step runs in apps/web/app/chat/from-share/[token]/ContinueSharedSession.tsx; I did not find its visible wording in the render, so the exact on-screen text while copying is unknown.
steps: Sign in, then open a public shared conversation link (/share/<token>).
Click Open in AGI in the top right of the header.
Wait for the page /chat/from-share/<token> to create your own conversation.
Send a new message in your own conversation and check it continues with the copied messages, compare with Expected.
S107.11.where: Open a shared link (/share/<token>) > Open in AGI

S107.12.note: The exact button label that sends the wizard prompt was not found; the link from a public example to the wizard is in GalleryClient.tsx, and the template page is apps/web/app/gallery/[templateId]/page.tsx.
steps: Open the gallery page at /gallery.
Click an example card or category, then fill in the wizard that opens.
Submit the wizard, which opens /chat with the prompt added as starterPrompt.
Check the prompt sits in the composer ready to send, and compare with Expected.
S107.12.where: Gallery > choose a category card > fill in the creation wizard > send (prompt opens in /chat)

S107.13.note: The viewer shows Shared by and the model only; I did not find copied-from, author or version wording in this viewer. The line is shown only when the share has a shared_by value.
steps: Open a public shared conversation link (/share/<token>) while signed out.
Look under the title for the line Shared by and the model badge.
Check the message count and Expires line also appear.
Compare with Expected: publisher and source shown, and check for copied-from or version information.
S107.13.where: Open a shared link (/share/<token>) > the line under the title that starts with Shared by

S107.15.needs: a signed-in account for the AI answer report
S107.15.note: The menu that opens Report this response was not confirmed; the AI-answer report goes to /api/content-report and the share-page link goes to the copyright notice form, which feeds a different queue.
steps: Open a public shared conversation link (/share/<token>) and scroll to the bottom.
Click Report infringement or impersonation and check the notice form opens.
In a chat, open the menu on an AI answer and click Report this response.
Check for the toast Reported. Thank you: our trust and safety team will review it., and compare with Expected.
S107.15.where: A public share page (/share/<token>) > Report infringement or impersonation. For an AI answer: the answer's menu > Report this response.

Look for the button Submit to the directory under the plugin details.
Click it and confirm in the dialog that opens.
Check the plugin shows as submitted and is named, and compare with Expected.
